title: platanthera bifolia var. latissima
intro: Platanthera bifolia var. latissima, commonly known as the green-veined orchid, is a type of orchid that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various diseases such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Platanthera bifolia var. latissima include expectorant and anti-tussive effects, which can help to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
